visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width banner with a background video or photo, a centred foreground product image and overlaid heading/intro text
visualCharacteristics.summary: Background video/poster plus a centred foreground product image, text overlaid bottom-left

contentPattern.summary: Banner with background video/poster + foreground device image, H2 and intro paragraph overlaid
contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image (the video poster), optionally plus a link or plain-text URL to an .mp4 background video; row 2: foreground product image followed by heading and paragraph(s)

reuseGuidance: Use when a banner layers a product cut-out over a background image or video. For a plain background image with a heading, use the base hero block.
